name: tpl-precedence-2-goal
task: Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. Reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once' is correctly the hard Precedence(door_open, key_lost) — the 'until the door has been opened once' wording makes Precedence the right template even though key_lost already encodes 'dropped while the door is shut', since the ban ends after the first door_open (key_lost can recur then and the task allows it). 'Reach the goal' is the hard Existence(at_goal), which is the only finishing event in the clues; the environment's constraints (at_goal needs door_open, door_open needs has_key) cover the prerequisites without extra clauses. Both clauses trace to task sentences, both are hard as worded, and there is no redundancy or added requirement.
